events.description: A man in a brown jacket is held at gunpoint by multiple armed soldiers while other soldiers restrain and hoist a bound prisoner on a bamboo structure; the scene depicts coercive control and threat of violence against a helpless individual.

Two rifles are visibly aimed directly at the man in the brown jacket, with barrels pointed at his head/upper torso, indicating an imminent or ongoing shooting threat; the guns are held steady and aligned for firing.

A man in a green uniform is restrained with ropes and held aloft by multiple individuals while being threatened at gunpoint; he shows visible injuries (blood on face) and distress, indicating he is a helpless victim of coercion or torture.

In frames f4–f5, two rifles are pointed directly at the central civilian man; one rifle (left) appears to have a muzzle flash or bright reflection consistent with discharge, though no definitive smoke or recoil is visible. Given the context and weapon orientation, a shot may have been fired, but visual evidence is ambiguous.

A man in a green uniform is restrained with ropes around his wrists, held aloft by others, and visibly screaming in pain or distress; he has facial injuries (blood on cheek and lip) and appears helpless while being subjected to coercion or torture.

A man in a brown jacket is surrounded by armed men pointing rifles at him; he displays escalating fear and distress (grimacing, flinching, crying, screaming), indicating he is being threatened or coerced under duress.

Multiple individuals (including the two previously restrained men) are simultaneously raising their arms in apparent collective distress or surrender amid smoke and chaotic background activity, suggesting a violent group confrontation or suppression event.

A man in a brown jacket is held at gunpoint by multiple armed individuals; he is visibly distressed, screaming, and later seen holding an AK-47 while still surrounded and threatened. Simultaneously, other men in green uniforms are shown with hands bound above their heads, being tortured or executed in a smoky outdoor setting.
Muzzle flash visible from an AK-47 held by the man in the brown jacket (frame f8), indicating active gunfire during that interval; corroborated by similar flash in f9.
A man in a brown jacket is held at gunpoint by multiple armed individuals; he screams with eyes shut while being physically restrained and threatened with rifles.
A different man in green military attire is suspended by his wrists from bamboo poles, screaming in pain or terror, with visible blood on his arms; others hold him aloft in a coercive setup.

The man in the brown jacket is again shown restrained, surrounded by armed men pointing rifles at him; his expression shifts from screaming to crying and distress over several seconds, indicating ongoing coercion and psychological/physical abuse.

A man is held at gunpoint by multiple armed individuals; he displays extreme distress (screaming, crying) while being physically restrained and threatened with firearms. The attackers are smiling and appear to be taunting him, indicating a non-combatant, helpless victim subjected to intimidation and coercion.

The previously distressed man transitions to holding a rifle and smiling broadly while surrounded by armed individuals who also smile and hold weapons; this suggests a shift from victimization to participation in a coordinated group action, likely a mock or staged combat scenario involving physical posturing and weapon handling among the group.
A man is held at gunpoint by multiple armed individuals; he appears distressed and is surrounded, with weapons pointed directly at him in a coercive, non-consensual manner.

Two soldiers in green uniforms are actively engaging in combat: one fires a rifle from behind a straw berm (visible muzzle flash/weapon recoil in f11–f15), while another advances and takes cover; the sequence shows sustained firing posture and tactical movement consistent with active shooting.
A soldier in green uniform is seen firing a rifle from behind a straw berm; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frames f3–f8, indicating active gunfire.
